sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Subhash Chand For the Petitioner : Md. Zaid Ahmed,
Advocate For the State : Mrs. Snehlika Bhagat, A.P.P.
---------
04/ 19.05.2023

This is the second Bail Application on behalf of the applicant-Santosh Karmali with the prayer to release on bail in connection with Gola P.S. Case No. 23 of 2022, corresponding to Special POCSO Case No. 10 of 2022, registered under Sections 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 & 8 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of the Additional Sessions Judge-I, Ramgarh.

Learned Counsel for the applicant has submitted that earlier first Bail Application of the applicant was rejected vide order dated 30th June, 2022 and by way of this present application, the prayer has been renewed for the reason that after rejection of the first Bail Application, the trial has commenced and out of 12 charge-sheeted witnesses, 05 witnesses were examined and victim also could not support the prosecution case as she was unable to say anything in regard to commission of the offence.
The learned A.P.P. opposed the contentions made by the learned Counsel for the applicant.
The first Bail Application of the applicant was rejected in B.A.No. 5227/2022 vide order dated 30.06.2022.
After rejection of the first Bail Application, trial has commenced.

If the victim has not supported the prosecution story, the testimony of victim or also the testimony of those witnesses,
who were examined before the trial court, cannot be evaluated at the time of disposal of second Bail Application.
In view of the above, Bail Application of the applicant is rejected.

(Subhash Chand, J.) P.K.S.
Santosh Karmali vs The State Of Jharkhand.
